selection.rationale: The accepted cut preserves the existing template anchors, including the phase switch from team_2 (seg:2) to team_1 (seg:3). The prior bridge segment already covers the immediate transition interval [1927.24, 1952.7]. To add at most one local story that contributes to the existing template without duplicating tried footage, I evaluated the fresh P1 candidates. interval_01:H1 is the strongest choice: it sits between seg:1 and seg:2, both team_2 attacking_threat anchors, and provides a non-replay, uncovered sequence of defensive recovery, dribble, defensive action, and shot. This reinforces the phase:1 team_2 threat run before the observed phase switch, without introducing causal claims beyond the supplied evidence. Other interval_01 candidates are weaker because they either rely on looser narrative associations (H2, H5), include replay events (H3), or describe a less direct attacking continuation (H4). interval_03 and interval_04 candidates are less suitable because they fall after the phase switch and would dilute the template's focus on the team_2-to-team_1 handoff. Therefore, interval_01:H1 is selected as the single additional local story.
